# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not report exploitable security issues in a public issue or pull
request. Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting for this repository from
the **Security** tab. Include the affected file or version, steps to reproduce,
and any suggested mitigation.

If private vulnerability reporting is unavailable, contact the repository
maintainers privately through GitHub before sharing technical details publicly.

## Supported versions

Security fixes are intended for the latest version on `main`. This is a course
project and does not currently publish supported release branches.
